definition_quote.value: "Polysomnography" means the treatment, management, diagnostic testing, education and care of patients with disorders related to sleep.
definition_quote.quote: "Polysomnography" means the treatment, management, diagnostic testing, education and care of patients with disorders related to sleep.

value: Supplemental low-flow oxygen therapy (up to 6 L/min)
Continuous or bilevel positive airway pressure titration
Sleep staging (surface EEG, surface electrooculography, submental surface EMG)
Audio or video monitoring of movement or behavior
Nocturnal penile tumescence monitoring (in approved facility)
Portable monitoring devices and other medical equipment used to treat sleep disorders
Analyzing data to assist physician diagnoses
Implementation and monitoring of durable medical equipment for sleep disorders
Patient and family education regarding testing and treatment
methods_authorized.quote: The use of the following during treatment, management, diagnostic testing, education and care of patients with disorders related to sleep: (A) Supplemental low-flow oxygen therapy, using up to six liters per minute of oxygen; (B) Continuous or bilevel positive airway pressure titration on spontaneously breathing patients using a mask or oral appliance

advisory_committee_composition.value: Seven members: three respiratory care practitioners, two individuals who practice polysomnography, one qualified medical director for polysomnography or respiratory care, and one member of the general public; all must be Oregon residents.
advisory_committee_composition.quote: The board consists of seven members appointed by the Governor and subject to confirmation by the Senate in the manner provided in ORS 171.562 and 171.565. All members of the board must be residents of this state. (2) Of the members of the board: (a) Three must be respiratory care practitioners; (b) Two must be individuals who practice polysomnography; (c) One must be a qualified medical director for polysomnography or for respiratory care; and (d) One must be a member of the general public.
